text.style: Style: lofi anime illustration like Studio Ghibli background paintings, combined with the dense cross-section composition and fine ink linework of a classic 1990s cutaway picture book. Soft cel shading, painterly textures, thin ink outlines. Night: warm amber lamplight, glowing paper lanterns and soft pastel neon signs inside, against the deep blue-black of space outside. People are drawn with slightly chunky storybook proportions (heads a little large, simple friendly faces), each one small but clearly readable.
text.inner: Subject: a giant spherical space station, as big as a small moon, floating in space at night, shown as a cutaway. The front of its grey armored hull is sliced away to reveal the inside, packed from top to bottom with many decks crammed on top of each other like a bustling night market stacked into an apartment block. A wide ring encircles the sphere, and docking arms reach out to the left and right to smaller cut-away modules (a greenhouse dome, a cargo dock with a little shuttle parked), so the whole station fills the wide frame. Inside: noodle and dumpling stalls with steaming pots and paper lanterns, a ramen counter with stools, glowing vending machines, a tea house, a tiny arcade, a karaoke booth, a hydroponic garden with tomatoes and herbs under grow lights, cramped cozy apartments with loft beds, beanbags, gaming setups and string lights, a laundromat with round washers, a workshop where a friendly robot is being repaired, a patch of artificial grass where two fawn-and-white boxer dogs play with a ball, a family kitchen with a rice cooker and shelves stacked with snacks and jars, a little clinic, a bakery, a bath house. Pipes, cables, ladders, glass elevators and pneumatic tubes connect everything. Dozens of cheerful people fill every room, each busy with their own task. Every surface is packed with unique, sensible objects: appliances, furniture, food, gadgets, tools, plants. All signs and labels are short and in English (NOODLES, DUMPLINGS, TEA, ARCADE, LAUNDRY, REPAIRS, DOG PARK, GARDEN, BAKERY, SNACKS). The top fifth of the image is calm starry space with nothing important in it. A glowing blue planet sits low on one side. Cozy, warm, happy and high-tech: nothing scary, no weapons, no danger.
text.cover: Use the reference image only to match the station's design, colours and painting style. Subject: the same giant spherical space station seen from outside at night, hull fully closed and intact: grey armored panels, the wide ring around it, docking arms, small blinking lights, rows of tiny warm glowing windows and paper-lantern light leaking from vents and hatches, hinting at the busy life inside. Near the centre, one big round porthole is lit warmly from inside, and in it a young man and two fawn-and-white boxer dogs press their faces to the glass, looking out happily. A small shuttle drifts past. A glowing blue planet below, deep starry space around. Tall portrait framing with the station filling the lower two thirds and calm starry space at the top for a clock. No text.
